note: Remote Chippewa National Forest campground on the west shore of Lake Winnibigoshish, in mature red and white pine; boat ramp and harbor next to it. Sites sit in the woods back from the shore. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS page read: $16 confirmed (2026-2028); 33 back-in sites 50-70 ft on rec.gov (FS says 35); reservable in peak season, FCFS Sep 5-Oct 13 2026; vault toilets. Waterfront: stored lakefront not supported - nearest sites ~60 m from the shore under continuous pine canopy -> lakeview lead. Phone 218-835-4291 on both official pages.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE LEAD: lakefront -> lakeview. Plotted the 33 rec.gov site points on Esri imagery: the closest sites to the Lake Winnibigoshish shore are 012 (47.42383,-94.31898), 013 (47.42406,-94.31878), 015 (47.42443,-94.31855), 024, 026 and 027, all about 60-65 m from the water's edge through continuous pine canopy (the 220 m frame shows unbroken crowns between the pads and a narrow shoreline strip). rec.gov tags 012, 013 and 015 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' but also 'Shade: Full'; its own description says only 'Some sites have lake views'. No site is within ~50 m over open ground, so the lakefront value is not earned; a lake view through the trees is what the description supports.

Phone: stored 218-335-8600 (Chippewa NF supervisor's office, in the FS page footer) -> 218-835-4291 (the campground's contact on the FS page, 'Phone: 218-835-4291', and recreation.gov facility_phone).

Drinking water: recreation.gov says 'hand-pumped drinking water' (amenity 'Drinking Water'), the FS page says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' Conflicting official pages; potable_water left unset.
Sites: rec.gov lists 33 sites (numbers 001-035 without 002 and 020); the FS page says 35. Count set to 33 from the booking catalog.

Season left unset: rec.gov's 2026 rate seasons run May 8 - Oct 13 (peak reservable to Sep 4, then FCFS), but a rate season is not a campground statement and the FS page's 'Seasons of Use' is blank ('Closed for the Season' today).
